title: Black Obsidian
description: A minimalist resource pack that replaces the default purple-tinted obsidian texture with a black tint.
body:
# 🖤 Black-Tinted Obsidian Pack

Tired of the prominent purple hue on the default obsidian texture in Minecraft? This minimalist resource pack tweaks the block's color profile, replacing the purple tint with a **clean, neutral black tint** while preserving all the original vanilla details and textures.

---

### ✨ Features:
* **Sleek Vanilla Look:** Keeps the classic texture pattern but swaps the purple tint for an authentic dark black look—perfect for modern builds, sleek Nether portals, or clean obsidian farms.
* **High Compatibility:** Natively optimized for Minecraft versions **1.21 through 1.21.11** using modern built-in format ranges to completely avoid pesky in-game incompatibility warnings.
